name: YouTube多频道发布-手动草稿与正式发布

data.description: 仅领取调度器已锁定的输入
data.code: const g=automaRefData('globalData'); const post=async(path,p)=>{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:18740/'+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Publisher-Key':g.bridge_key},body:JSON.stringify(p)});const x=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error(x.error);return x;};post('input',{gm:g.gm}).then(p=>{automaSetVariable('payload',p);automaSetVariable('last_error','');automaNextBlock();}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);throw e;});

data.description: 正式发布前持久化授权和检查证据
data.code: const g=automaRefData('globalData'); const post=async(path,p)=>{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:18740/'+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Publisher-Key':g.bridge_key},body:JSON.stringify(p)});const x=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error(x.error);return x;};const p=automaRefData('variables','payload');if(p.mode==='public'){post('prepare-publish',{key:p.id,token:p.token,channel_id:p.channel_id}).then(()=>automaNextBlock()).catch(e=>{throw e;});}else{automaNextBlock();}

data.description: 选择可见性；根据发布开关提交

data.code: const g=automaRefData('globalData'); const post=async(path,p)=>{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:18740/'+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Publisher-Key':g.bridge_key},body:JSON.stringify(p)});const x=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error(x.error);return x;};const error=automaRefData('variables','last_error');const p=automaRefData('variables','payload');if(error){post('report',{key:p.id,token:p.token,channel_id:p.channel_id,state:'结果待核查',error}).then(()=>{throw new Error(error)});}else{automaNextBlock();}

data.description: 发布成功后关闭任务页；草稿调试时禁用
确认草稿或正式发布结果及视频ID
data.code: const g=automaRefData('globalData'); const post=async(path,p)=>{const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:18740/'+path,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Publisher-Key':g.bridge_key},body:JSON.stringify(p)});const x=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error(x.error);return x;};const p=automaRefData('variables','payload');post(p.mode==='public'?'confirm-public':'confirm-draft',{key:p.id,token:p.token,channel_id:p.channel_id,public_selected:automaRefData('variables','public_selected')===true}).then(()=>automaNextBlock()).catch(e=>{console.error(e);throw e;});
